status: Accepted OMF reading/lifetime approach; detailed format and field rules remain under review.

authorization.statement: OK, let's lock that reading approach in for Bella. Next, let's look at OMF versions and text encoding. How do Media Composer, MDVX and MediaMuster handle them, and what should Bella do?
authorization.scope: Accepts TOC-driven selective acquisition and compact retention/release. Starts OMF version/text review, without accepting its future rules or a general project/sequence importer.

agreedBellaRules.navigation: Independent OMF parser: locate supported label/TOC or embedded graph, capture TOC once, read required definitions, active ownership/links and selected value ranges. No whole-media image or MXF front-header assumption.
agreedBellaRules.retention: Owned compact results and necessary exact numeric/format/availability data; release temporary bytes/indexes/relationships. Do not retain broad raw property graph or per-row header copies.
agreedBellaRules.requiredContext: Read required definitions and ownership/reference context with the requested values. Validate ranges and skip known recording payloads and proven unneeded metadata. Native WAV/AIFF and embedded OMF remain one physical file.
agreedBellaRules.independence: New OMF parser, separate from scanner and MDB reader, using small C++17/Qt6.5.3 helpers. No adaptation/cutover of OldScanner.
agreedBellaRules.separateDecisions: OMF versions, text decoding, exact field sources/ownership and damage rules remain for focused review. Cross-source priorities, extra reads and concurrency remain later decisions.
agreedBellaRules.performance: No measured scan-time or peak-memory improvement claimed; current raw graph is already temporary.
